name: crm.web.scraper
description: Scrape and crawl provider directories, NPI registries, telehealth hubs, nursing boards, and social media profiles to build the CRM contact database. Targets: Doximity, Zocdoc, Healthgrades, Vitals, AMA, AANP, LinkedIn, Twitter.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Identify target provider segments and sources
steps.prompt: As a healthcare market intelligence agent, identify the top 10 specific search queries or directory pages to scrape for: 1) Telehealth-ready physicians (Family Med, Internal Med, Psych, Dermatology) 2) Nurse Practitioners open to telehealth 3) Healthcare investors active on LinkedIn/Twitter. For each: exact URL pattern, expected data fields, contact volume estimate. Be specific.

steps.name: Query NPI Registry for providers by specialty
steps.query: SELECT name, url, source_type, last_scraped_at FROM crm_scrape_sources WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY last_scraped_at ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5

steps.name: Compile scraping plan for operator approval
Submit scraping plan for Operator approval
